name: Moon Garden story-page reconstruction
prompt: Recreate the attached Moon Garden reference as an original 256×144 Open Dots page. Start with get_pixel_art_guide and get_storybook, create a named palette, then decompose the scene into reusable assets: Mira, the fox, the gardening robot, moonflower, greenhouse, bench, telescope, lanterns, pots, plants, books, watering can, skyline, wall, tiles, and stepping stones. Build assets in outline, fill, shade, and highlight passes; inspect their PNGs; stamp them back-to-front with visible overlap; add the exact text ‘Mira found the moon garden.’ as rasterized page text; inspect the final page and iterate. Preserve the reference’s composition, silhouettes, depth, and mood while deliberately simplifying micro-detail for the 256×144 limit; do not copy pixels literally.

rubric.name: composition
rubric.criteria: Recognizable rooftop moon garden with a quiet route to the central flower and clear foreground, midground, and background depth.

rubric.name: characters
rubric.criteria: Mira, fox, and robot are distinct, readable, posed around the flower, and grounded with overlap or contact shadows.

rubric.name: assets_and_density
rubric.criteria: Scene feels full and assembled from many coherent reusable elements rather than a few large flat blocks.

rubric.name: pixel_craft
rubric.criteria: At 256×144: intentional silhouettes, clustered pixels, consistent lighting, and outline/base/shadow/highlight material ramps; fine reference detail is simplified rather than reproduced as noise.

rubric.name: story_text
rubric.criteria: The exact sentence ‘Mira found the moon garden.’ is legible, rasterized into the page, and placed without a caption box.

rubric.name: palette_and_mood
rubric.criteria: Moonlit indigo atmosphere with warm lantern accents and a mint-cyan magical focal glow.
